title: The NF-operator and the NF-Numbers of Simplicial Complexes
summary: Let $\bigtriangleup$ be a simplicial complex and let $δ_{\mathcal{NF}}$ denote the NF-operator. The NF-complex $δ_{\mathcal{NF}}(\bigtriangleup)$ is defined as the Stanley--Reisner complex of the facet ideal of $\bigtriangleup$. Iterating $δ_{\mathcal{NF}}$ gives a periodic orbit (up to isomorphism), and the smallest positive integer $t$ for which $δ_{\mathcal{NF}}^{\,t}(\bigtriangleup)\cong \bigtriangleup$ is called the \emph{NF-number} of $\bigtriangleup$ (Habi and Mahmood, Algebra Colloquium, 2022). In this work, we provide various results and determine explicit formulas for the NF-number…
